hero.title: Clear signage. Advertising that stands out.
hero.description: We design, produce and install road signage, vehicle license plates and advertising materials for municipalities and institutions in Kosovo and the region.

signGrid.line2: Built for roads that never sleep.

highlights.description: Clear visual and technical concept before production.

highlights.title: Production

highlights.title: Installation

about.mission: We make public space safer and easier to navigate. Since 2018, TSR has worked with municipalities and institutions across Kosovo — from road signage and vehicle license plates to street naming and fiber optic networks.
story: We work with municipalities, public institutions and international partners.
Our approach is minimal, functional and long-term.
From concept to final installation, everything comes from one team.

values.title: Precision
values.description: Every measurement, cut and placement held to tight tolerances — from design file to installed sign.

values.title: Safety
values.description: We follow road and construction codes so signs protect and direct in equal measure.

values.title: Durability
values.description: Materials chosen for years of reliable service, tested before they leave the workshop.

values.title: Clarity
values.description: Straightforward communication from quote to handover — no surprises, no subcontractors.

process.title: Design
process.description: Site visit, technical brief, documented concept. Every project is planned before a single cut is made.

process.title: Production
process.description: In-house manufacturing with reflective films, aluminum composites and structural steel.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our team handles on-site placement, leveling and final documentation. No subcontractors.

hero.title: Our services
hero.description: Complete solutions from concept to field delivery.

items.title: Vehicle License Plates
items.summary: Production of vehicle registration plates for Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia.
details: The service is available for Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia.
All accompanying machinery for vehicle license plate production is in service.
Produced to the technical specifications and safety standards of each country.

items.title: Signage
items.summary: Horizontal and vertical signage, traffic lights and road signs to standard.
details: Horizontal signage: lane lines, pedestrian crossings and road markings.
Vertical signage: road, directional and warning signs with reflective film.
Installation and maintenance of traffic lights for urban intersections.

items.title: Advertising
items.summary: Advertising solutions for facades, storefronts and interior spaces.
details: Visual identity design for a stronger brand presence.
Material processing in PVC, alubond and acrylic.
Illuminated and non-illuminated installation by location.

items.title: Street Naming
items.summary: Street and square name signs, unified across the whole municipality.
details: Unified design following the municipality's visual identity.
Made from weather- and UV-resistant materials.
Mounted on walls, poles or dedicated structures.

items.title: Building and House Numbering
items.summary: Number plates for buildings, apartments and houses, linked to municipal addresses.
details: Systematic numbering coordinated with the municipal address register.
Plates readable day and night, with reflective material.
Fast on-site installation for entire neighborhoods.

items.title: Railway Infrastructure Works
items.summary: Signage and supporting works along railway lines and stations.
details: Vertical and directional signage for lines, crossings and stations.
Field works in compliance with railway safety regulations.
Coordination with operators and responsible institutions.

items.title: Asphalt Products
items.summary: The full range of asphalt products, directly from German manufacturer DGA Dortmund.
details: All asphalt products for road construction and maintenance.
Supply from the manufacturer and trading of DGA Dortmund products.
Technical advice on choosing and applying the right product.

partner.name: DGA Dortmund
partner.note: TSR represents DGA Dortmund in the Balkans.

items.title: 5G Fiber Optic Network
items.summary: Laying of fiber optic cables and infrastructure for 5G networks.
details: Trenching and laying of ducts and fiber optic cables.
Infrastructure ready for 5G networks and high-speed internet.
Surface restoration and signage of road works.

iso.label: Certified
iso.title: International standards at every step.
iso.body: TSR LLC operates under an integrated management system certified to international ISO standards for quality, environment, information security, road traffic safety and occupational health and safety. From design through production to on-site installation, every process is documented and audited.
